Phainon had perfected this song and dance; Perfected how easily it was to make everyone swoon over him and call him a model student. 

Gleaming smiles, carefree personality, always so kind to everyone, it was incredibly easy for him to woo anyone to his side. 

Until he met him.

Phainon’s eyes burned. They ached with a fire he didn’t know existed, and yet he ignored it - He didn’t want to blink to stop the pain, he didn’t want to look away from him for one second.

The new transfer student; Mydei.

Even while he stood in the front of the homeroom, being introduced like they were still toddlers and not seniors - Phainon couldn’t bear the idea of looking away from him.

Those golden eyes behind his red-rimmed glasses weren’t sharing that sentiment, though. Instead looking at apparently nothing to the side and on the wall - his face lightly dusted a red hue, embarrassed about having to stand up there probably. 

His attire made Phainon almost drool - A tight black shirt with a dark brown cardigan, incredibly simple, and finished off with black pants. That shouldn’t be such a turn on - but for some reason Phainon already found his cock twitching in his own pants for this man.

Phainon only had one qualm about this beautiful new transfer student.

Phainon hated it. 

He hated the way those golden eyes finally looked at someone - the complete opposite side of the room from Phainon. He hated the feeling that rose into his chest, the way he felt almost sick immediately, nauseated to wander who had attracted his attention before Phainon. He couldn’t help but tap a finger on his desk, almost desiring to claw into the plastic wood until his fingers bled.

Phainon straightened himself, putting on his best smile. Fine. If he had to work to earn his attention he would, Phainon was used to doing that!

“Nice to meet you, Mydei!” His voice came out loudly, happy, chipper - because he meant those words. He was very glad to meet this beautiful person, and he only wanted to know him more.

Those amber eyes moved to him at that, and Phainon only basked in the feeling that came with it - in knowing this beautiful stranger thought he was worth the time of day. Mydei didn’t reply - but that was fine! Those dazzling eyes acknowledging him alone made his breath stutter easily.

Phainon couldn’t help but tense - a feeling he had never felt before crept into him as his ears focused on what the whisper said behind him.

“What kind of delinquent gets a tattoo on his face?”

Mydei’s eyes left him and Phainon immediately bit into his own cheek at that, barely able to hear his own thoughts over his heartbeat - over the whispers reaching his ears. It burned. He hated this, hearing people talk about Mydei as the man in question was talking to the teacher. 

He hated this. 

Phainon could only perk up again when Mydei’s eyes returned only briefly - not settling on him but clearly looking around.

A seat.

Phainon copied, eyes desperately praying people had left somewhere near him open - they never did, he was too popular. But.. Maybe today if he was lucky..?

Phainon tasted blood on his tongue as he bit open his lip, the tangy metallic taste seeping onto his tongue as his eyes finally found the same thing Mydei did. The only empty seat in the room, completely across the way as far away from Phainon as possible.

“We’re so young too.. Did he just want to ruin his life before it started?”

The whispers started again so quietly as Mydei walked to the seat, either unable to hear them or zoning them out. But the idea of Mydei hearing them around Phainon and thinking he had any part of them..

“Scary.. He’s so muscular too.. Was he in some gang fights and got expelled?”

Phainon had to try to steady himself, turning with a fake smile on his lips to stare at the people behind him - hollowly, angrily, feelings he didn’t even know he could feel until now felt like they were going to choke him. 

“Please be nice to our new transfer student!”

Phainon said those words, so happily, so sweetly - Balling his hands into a clenched fist on his desk. He wanted to hit them. He wanted to hit them so very badly, to make sure they didn’t spread rumors about Mydei again. Make sure they understand the price of doing that. 

Phainon could only turn around slowly back to facing the front, still chewing on his lips, eyes darting restlessly to try to catch a glimpse of Mydei in the back. 

Miserable..

Well!

If people were going to be mean and act afraid of Mydei - He knew a student council leader more than willing to show him around and be his first friend here! The thought alone satiated his spiraling emotions minisculely  - Mydei’s first friend. He would claim such a title easily. 

He couldn’t do anything but stare at the clock - incessantly tapping on his desk to try to make every minute pass by faster. He would show Mydei to his next class no matter what, even if he was late to his own and ruined his perfect record he had kept all his life. So what? 

Even as the people around him tried to spark up conversations - he couldn’t focus on whatever dabble they were talking about. His mind could only wonder what Mydei’s voice sounded like, was it deep? Was it soft? Rough around the edges? Smooth?

Even as he turned to fakely smile at his friends and chat idly, his eyes only wandered to where Mydei was sitting - barely visible from where Phainon was, frustratingly.

Not with Mydei existing in his life now. It was incredibly hard, he found his eyes wandering and his head tilting to look at his fellow classmate who was seemingly reading a book.

Phainon briefly felt bad - usually new students were hounded, pestered by everyone around them to talk about themself and their life. But no one was paying attention to Mydei - if anything, it seemed like they were trying to ignore him. Phainon felt bad about that, he did! But also elated. He desperately wanted to be Mydei’s guide - no one else.

Phainon found the wind being stolen from his lungs as Mydei grabbed the hem of his shirt tightly - so very firmly to drag him a few inches closer, just enough to glare a fiery and piercing look into Phainon’s own eyes.

“Stop attacking people on my behalf.” 

Those words made Phainon’s blood run cold, icy and decaying as his fingers felt numb - still, he couldn’t help but crack a small smile, solely due to the fact Mydei was at least holding onto him.

It was a ghost of a threat, he knew that hold on him was, but it did nothing to help elevate the way he just wanted Mydei again - another round in the bathroom, maybe.

Instead, he had to swallow those feelings down and tilted his head; “.. You knew?”

That question left his lips so quietly that he wasn’t even shocked when Mydei’s eyes only narrowed towards him.

“Not until just now, it was just a guess with how you were talking to me during sex and right now.” 

Mydei’s words were curiously lacking in venom, as if he wasn’t actually overly bothered by the idea of someone attacking his dejectors - more bothered by the apparent burden it put on him than the actual idea of others being hurt.

And something about that look, that fiery look that was perturbed - but not for the right reasons, drove Phainon insane. 

“.. Haha..” Was all Phainon could manage to say, feeling his own skin burning beneath that gaze - he had once thought he was in control here, but as Mydei held him so firmly in place..

He only felt more and more turned on, like he hadn’t just came inside Mydei twice just a few minutes before. Trapped like a rat in a cage, and aching for whatever else Mydei would give to him.

“Can you do that for me?” Mydei asked with eyes that read as dangerous, but Phainon wasn’t even quite convinced it was towards him in specific. If anything, he felt like Mydei was angry that.. 

“No.” Phainon decided before giving a small laugh - an incredibly simple thing.

It was funny. This was the one thing he wouldn’t do for Mydei, anything else and he would.

This?

He couldn’t.

Mydei was his - and he would do anything to protect that small piece of paradise he had found and claimed for himself. 

“.. No? You said anything.” Mydei slowly questioned, almost seeming completely baffled by that one word - obviously, he hadn’t expected to be flat out rejected.

And the shock Mydei felt only made Phainon burn in his skin - awkwardly shuffling against the lockers; “I only do that for your sake..”

Mydei didn’t seem convinced of that, instead moving to free Phainon - moving to cross his arms over his chest and tilt his head to the side as he eyed Phainon; “It doesn’t help, now people just think I attack anyone that talks badly about me in my free time.”

Phainon only blinked at that.

That idea was an interesting one, but Phainon could only focus on one undeniable thing that Mydei was alluding to;  “Are you just angry I’ve only been attacking people that talk bad about you?”

Mydei didn’t like the idea that people thought he himself was behind the attacks. That was obvious.

Mydei only stared at him for a brief second, mouth agape, before he barely managed one singular word; “.. What?”

Phainon only found himself smiling easily however, almost blissfully as he leaned closer again - desperate to be near Mydei again even though he hadn’t even moved too far.

Phainon dragged his fingers against the metallic lockers behind him achingly - aching to touch Mydei more than anything else in the world.

“I’ll mix it up, I’ll attack others you don’t even have a single connection to.” Phainon’s voice had dropped dangerously, so quietly, so very reverently for the man he was speaking to. An oath of sheer devotion, and one he was wholly committed to.

“.. You’re insane.”

Those words from Mydei never got any less funny to Phainon’s ears, always easily rattling his brain around and making him fight the urge to bite down the laugh he felt.

He was insane, sure.

He didn’t care, either! Which was more important.

Instead, he only found himself knitting his brows together, preparing his best whimpering voice before he decided to plead with the man; “Please.. I can’t.. I can’t let them talk badly about you, Mydei.”

Phainon blinked wet - glassy eyes at him, eyes that were begging more than Phainon’s own words ever could as he forced out a small sniffling noise.

“Fine.”

That lone word uttered from Mydei’s mouth as he moved a few feet away made Phainon’s head absolutely reel in confusion, barely able to fully stand up straight as he followed Mydei into the middle of the hall.

Eyes wide over that word; “What? Really?”

Mydei didn’t even bat an eye, instead wholly focused on digging out his phone from his pocket to seemingly check something before glancing at Phainon; “I’m kind of used to it.”

“.. What? Really?” Phainon found himself asking again - eyes wide and blinking excessively, because what the hell did that mean? 

Used to people attacking others on his behalf?

The thought of others trying to get Mydei’s attention just like Phainon was made his skin itch with jealousy again.. 

“My father hires hitmen a lot, if I squint, you’re kind of like that, I guess.”

Oh.

No, yeah, that didn’t help Phainon here who only moved to be closer to Mydei, blinking as he tried to understand those words; “.. Huh?”

Though, he did imagine it made sense - Phainon hadn’t snooped too much about Mydei’s family, but he knew they were high class, extremely wealthy folks.

Not that Phainon cared. He just wanted Mydei for Mydei, anyway. 

“Nothing. Whatever. Just stop being obvious about your targets, I don’t know your logic behind it all.”

“You really won’t turn me in?” It all felt so surreal, Phainon was powerless to stop the evident shock that was laced into every word he spoke, blinking widely at Mydei.

And.. Much to Phainon’s own confusion and maybe a bit of joy, Mydei only shrugged before giving him a grin of all things;  “I guess not.”

“Wow… Your morals are really bad!” Phainon immediately teased back, though he couldn’t help but mirror Mydei’s expression so so joyfully. 

“Okay. Bold of you to be saying that.” Mydei fired back as he shook his head.

Phainon didn’t mind, he knew this thing he felt so deeply for Mydei was something more twisted than normal love - but it was fine, wasn’t it? Mydei seemed almost willing to allow him his fantasies..

“Will you tutor me again, by the way? This was really fun, dearest.” Phainon asked as he took up Mydei’s arm, bringing it to his chest and clinging onto it tightly - only smugly smiling as Mydei gave him a rather baffled look.

One that was cute, considering Phainon was taller than him.

Mydei considered it for a moment before only quietly scoffing under his breath; “.. You’re really struggling?”

Phainon gave a laugh over that, over the way Mydei seemed wholly confused by that; “What? You thought I was lying to get close to you? I wish! I’m failing..”

Mydei tried to pull on his arm at that, gently albeit, but he did try. Not that Phainon budged at all, and that easily made Mydei sigh under his breath; “Good lord.”

“Is that a yes? To dating me and being my tutor?” Phainon only instantly continued, holding onto his arm for dear life - because this was his entire life at stake!

His entire life with Mydei in the future! 

Mydei stared at him for a moment before glancing at his phone with his free hand, blinking at it before looking back at him; “Wow, lumping them both together now? Bold, aren’t you?”

Phainon only blinked wetly at him, pathetically; “Please say yes.”

“Alright.” Mydei flatly replied, and that was enough to make Phainon blink his eyes even more dramatically, trying his best to even understand if he had heard the man correctly. 

“To.. Both?” Phainon rather timidly asked, easily earning a small glare sent to him by Mydei - one that only made Phainon tighten his hold on the man’s muscular arm almost possessively. 

Mydei appeared almost amused by that, only staring at Phainon as he slowly raised a brow curiously at him; “Is it that shocking when we just had sex in the bathroom?”

Phainon almost felt silly for that, almost! 

But if Mydei had assumed it was just a fun little time waste quickie.. 

“Well.. Yes?” Phainon said in a small voice, shrugging his shoulders innocently as Mydei scoffed at him - shaking his sunset colored head.

“Mydei.. One last thing..”

Phainon could only swallow harshly, trying his best to get rid of the lump in his  throat as he thought about the walk back to the classroom - only blinking back tears the more he thought about the issue at hand.

“What?”

“You’re limping..”

“Be quiet.”
